name: orbit-loader
title: Orbit Loader
description: Dots circling on nested rings at different speeds. Under reduced motion it holds one evenly spread frame.

props.name: dots
props.description: Number of orbiting dots (1 to 5), each on its own ring.

props.name: duration
props.description: Seconds for the outermost dot to circle once; inner dots are faster.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes; the dots take the text color.
